verdict.rationale: Airweave is a retrieval and context layer for AI agents, so published recall-accuracy benchmarks are a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no published benchmark results (LongMemEval, LoCoMo or otherwise). The only accuracy evidence is one anecdotal community comment praising retrieval accuracy, which is not a published benchmark.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published memory-quality benchmark results (e.g. LongMemEval, LoCoMo) backing the product's recall-accuracy claims
